situations.title: 외과적 손씻기 절차
situations.tagline: Start at the fingertips and work down to the elbows, one hand at a time.
situations.brief: surgical scrub 순서를 손끝에서 팔꿈치까지 단계별로 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Keep your hands above your elbows the whole time.
Scrub each finger, then the palm, then the forearm.
Don't let the lather run back down onto your hands.

situations.title: 무균 가운 착용
situations.tagline: Let me open the gown for you so you only touch the inside.
situations.brief: 순회간호사의 도움을 받아 가운을 무균으로 착용하세요.
keyPhrases: Hold the gown by the inside shoulder seams only.
Slide your arms in but stop at the cuffs.
I'll tie the back so you stay sterile in front.

situations.title: 폐쇄식 장갑 착용
situations.tagline: Keep your hands inside the cuffs and I'll guide the closed-glove technique.
situations.brief: 소매 안에 손을 둔 채 closed gloving 기법으로 장갑을 착용하세요.
keyPhrases: Keep your fingers inside the cuff, don't push through yet.
Grab the glove through the gown sleeve.
Now work your hand into the glove and unroll the cuff.
goals: 손이 소매 밖으로 나오지 않게 한다

situations.title: 손 무균 건조
situations.tagline: Blot from fingertips to elbow and toss the towel before it doubles back.
situations.brief: 무균 수건으로 손끝에서 팔꿈치 방향으로 눌러 건조하세요.
keyPhrases: Blot, don't rub, and always move toward the elbow.
Use one side of the towel per hand.
Drop the towel once you reach the elbow.
goals: 수건 한 면당 한 손만 사용한다

situations.title: 손톱·장신구 제거
situations.tagline: Rings, watch, and polish all come off before you touch the sink.
situations.brief: 착용 전 손톱과 장신구를 제거해 무균 준비를 하세요.
keyPhrases: Take off your ring and watch before scrubbing.
Nails need to be short with no polish or gel.
Nothing on your hands past the wrist.

situations.title: 두 번째 착용자 보조
situations.tagline: You're already sterile, so open-glove me while I keep my hands out.
situations.brief: 이미 무균인 동료가 두 번째 착용자에게 개방식 장갑을 끼워 주도록 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: Hold the glove open with your fingers under the cuff.
I'll drop my hand straight in, don't touch my skin.
Now stretch the cuff over my gown sleeve.

situations.title: 장갑 천공 발견
situations.tagline: I felt a nick on my glove, let's break scrub and reglove me now.
situations.brief: 착용 중 장갑 손상을 발견하면 즉시 교체하도록 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: I think my glove is compromised, I need a fresh pair.
Open me a new glove and I'll reglove closed.
Don't touch the field until I'm regloved.

situations.title: 손씻기 중 오염 재시작
situations.tagline: My hand brushed the faucet, so I'm starting the whole scrub over.
situations.brief: scrub 중 오염이 발생하면 처음부터 다시 시작하도록 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: I touched the sink, that counts as contaminated.
There's no shortcut, I have to restart the scrub.
Grab me a new brush and sponge, please.

situations.title: 가운 소매 오염
situations.tagline: The sleeve dragged the back table, so that arm isn't sterile anymore.
situations.brief: 가운 소매가 오염되면 무균을 다시 확보하도록 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: My cuff touched a non-sterile edge.
The forearm and cuff are the trickiest to keep sterile.
I'll need a sterile sleeve cover or a regown.
goals: 필요 시 재가운·소매 커버로 무균을 회복한다

situations.title: 이중 장갑 착용 판단
situations.tagline: This is an ortho case with sharp hardware, so let's double glove.
situations.brief: 손상 위험이 높은 수술에서 double gloving 적용을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: Sharp instruments and bone mean we double glove.
Put a larger pair underneath for comfort.
The colored indicator layer shows any perforation.
goals: 수술 위험도에 따라 이중 장갑을 결정한다

situations.title: 라텍스 장갑 대체
situations.tagline: The patient has a latex allergy, so pull only latex-free gloves for this room.
situations.brief: 라텍스 알레르기 환자를 위해 라텍스 프리 장갑을 선택하세요.
keyPhrases: This patient is latex-allergic, so nitrile only.
Double-check every glove box says latex-free.
Swap out any latex products on the field.

situations.title: 착용 중 필드 접촉
situations.tagline: You reached over the sterile field before you were gloved, let's fix that.
situations.brief: 착용 순서 중 무균 필드를 접촉한 오염을 바로잡으세요.
keyPhrases: Your bare arm crossed the sterile field.
Step back and regown before you touch anything.
We'll recover the field where you brushed it.

situations.title: 손 상처·피부염 상태
situations.tagline: You've got an open cut on your hand, so let's talk about whether you should scrub in.
situations.brief: 손 상처나 피부염 상태에서 수술 참여 여부를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: An open lesion is a route for contamination.
Cover it, or you may need to sit this case out.
Let's check policy before you scrub in.
goals: 손 상처가 무균에 미치는 위험을 평가한다

situations.title: 장시간 수술 장갑 교체
situations.tagline: We're past two hours, so let's swap gloves before the barrier breaks down.
situations.brief: 장시간 수술에서 주기적으로 장갑을 교체하도록 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Gloves lose integrity after long wear, time to change.
I'll open a fresh pair and you reglove closed.
Let's set a reminder for the next glove change.

situations.title: 가운 사이즈 부적합
situations.tagline: This gown's too small to wrap fully, so let's regown before we lose the sterile back.
situations.brief: 가운 사이즈가 맞지 않으면 무균 유지를 위해 교체하세요.
keyPhrases: The gown won't close in back, that's a sterility gap.
Grab me the next size up.
Let's regown before we start prepping.
goals: 가운 사이즈 문제로 인한 무균 위험을 판단한다

situations.title: 수술 중 장갑 관통
situations.tagline: My glove just tore against the retractor, break scrub and get me a new pair now.
situations.brief: 수술 중 장갑 관통을 즉시 교체하고 보고하도록 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: My glove is torn, I need to reglove immediately.
Step back from the wound while I change.
We need to document this glove breach.
goals: 관통 즉시 장갑을 교체하고 필드를 보호한다

situations.title: 혈액 노출 사고
situations.tagline: Blood splashed into my eye, someone start the exposure protocol with me.
situations.brief: 혈액 노출 사고 발생 시 노출 후 프로토콜을 시작하세요.
keyPhrases: I had a blood splash to my eye, I'm flushing now.
We need source patient labs and the exposure form.
Get someone to relieve me at the field.
goals: 즉시 세척하고 노출 후 프로토콜을 개시한다

situations.title: 바늘 자상 동시 오염
situations.tagline: I got a needlestick and it's contaminated, help me start the sharps injury steps.
situations.brief: 바늘 자상과 오염이 동시에 발생한 상황에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Sharps injury, I'm bleeding it out under water now.
That needle was in the surgical field.
Page occupational health and pull the source labs.
goals: 자상 부위를 세척하고 노출 프로토콜을 시작한다
오염 경위를 보고하고 후속 검사를 준비한다

situations.title: 무균 위반 은폐 목격
situations.tagline: I saw that break in technique, and we can't just cover it up.
situations.brief: 무균 위반을 은폐하려는 상황을 목격하고 보고하도록 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: That contamination has to be called out.
Patient safety comes before saving face.
We need to break scrub and document it.
goals: 환자 안전을 위한 시정과 보고를 요구한다

situations.title: 응급 신속 무균 착용
situations.tagline: This is a crash open, gown and glove me fast but don't skip sterility.
situations.brief: 응급 상황에서 신속하면서도 무균을 지키며 착용하세요.
keyPhrases: Fast but clean, open my gown and gloves.
Call out any break, we're moving quick.
I'm gloved, hand me the blade.

situations.title: 미착용자 필드 진입
situations.tagline: Stop, you're not sterile, step back from the field right now.
situations.brief: 미착용자가 무균 필드에 진입하면 즉시 차단하세요.
keyPhrases: You're unsterile, back away from the table.
Anything you touched is now contaminated.
Give us a wide margin around the field.
